name: sndk-jev label spec
purpose: Every label the state builder writes or could write, with the logic under it. Built labels are checked against the code by a test. Free and new labels are designs, not code.

statuses.blocked: needs data SNDK PRO does not store

types.distance: how far, in sigma, today's expected move
types.rank: where it sits against its own history at the same time of day
types.share: one part against the whole, or one window against another
types.state: which of a few named situations

how_one_label_is_built: pick the moment: one scan row is now, plus only the minutes that had already closed
take the raw numbers untouched; if one is missing, stop and record why
put the number on a scale: divide by sigma, or rank it against past sessions at this clock time
judge it against a fixed cut, in code
write one sentence that carries the number and the cut
hand it to the packer, which gives each question only the sentences it names

viewpoints.title: The strikes: distance, action, clusters
viewpoints.intuition: Viewing all the strikes and their distance from the current price, measuring the amount of action including calls or puts traded, general GEX readings per strike, clusters and size to determine support or resistance.
viewpoints.review: The weakest area today. Every built label collapses the board to one number. Nothing shows the ladder strike by strike. The free labels add size and freshness; the new ones add the ladder and the clusters. SNDK PRO measured walls as not acting as levels and strikes as not pinning on this name, so these describe structure, and whether JEV reads a cluster as support is for the grading loop to decide.

viewpoints.title: Volume and price action
viewpoints.review: How much volume and whether it backs the move are built. Where the volume traded and which way it leaned are not, and both come straight from the stored bars.

viewpoints.title: Yesterday and the day before
viewpoints.intuition: How the price has been moving and where it has been touching, compared with yesterday and the day before.
viewpoints.review: Nothing today references yesterday's high, low or close. The only backward look ranks today's range against five sessions. With 18 days of bars stored, yesterday's levels and the touches on them are cheap.

viewpoints.title: RSI and the other intraday metrics
viewpoints.intuition: A measurement of things like RSI and other intraday metrics.
viewpoints.review: The 1-minute RSI read between on 62 of 64 sampled moments, which is the noisy end of useful. A 5-minute RSI and the duration of an extreme are the two honest additions. The implied-volatility labels sit here too, as the options market's own metrics.

viewpoints.title: Space and time
viewpoints.intuition: Spatial and time awareness: distance from the beginning to the end of the market, and price location compared with everything else including its own past.
viewpoints.review: Time is covered by session phase, expiry and the time-of-day baselines. Space against the multi-day past is the gap: position in the last five sessions' range, distance to the week's extremes, and how long since price last really moved.

viewpoints.title: Framing, not one of the five
viewpoints.intuition: What JEV needs in order to read everything else.
viewpoints.review: Sent with every request. Static text plus the two clocks.

viewpoints.title: News, outside the five
viewpoints.intuition: Will it move price, and is it already priced in.
viewpoints.review: Built and tested, waiting on a feed. Nexus holds SanDisk items but stopped ingesting on 6 September.

labels.from: constant
labels.logic: static text
labels.reads_as: SNDK

labels.from: constant
labels.logic: static text defining sigma and the sign convention
labels.reads_as: all distances are in sigma, today's expected-move unit for SanDisk; a plus sign means above price and a minus sign means below price. Options weight means the hedging exposure of dealers, the market makers on the other side of the options, at each strike; a wall is a strike where that weight piles up; the opening box is the first half hour's price range; RSI is a 0 to 100 gauge of overbought (above 70) or oversold (below 30)

labels.from: constant
labels.logic: static text
labels.reads_as: the next 30 minutes
labels.note: changed from 60 to 30 minutes on 2026-09-22; the sum is asked at the 30-minute mark

labels.from: meta.expiries, the front weekly's date and days to expiry
labels.logic: calendar distance to the front weekly
labels.cut: 0 today; 1 tomorrow; same ISO week is later this week; otherwise next week or later
labels.reads_as: the front weekly expires today

labels.from: the row's timestamp
labels.logic: minutes since the open over the 390 in a session
labels.reads_as: 100% of the session has passed, the last fifth; the last hour, 0 minutes before the close
labels.note: revised 2026-09-21 after the overlap review; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. now also names the phase (first hour, middle, last hour) with minutes after the open and before the close; context.session_phase folded in

labels.from: today's finished bars; sigma
labels.logic: minutes since the last 10-minute span in which price moved 0.15 sigma or more
labels.reads_as: price last made a real move of 0.15 sigma within 10 minutes 1 minute ago, under 10 minutes ago
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: spot; the close of the bar that finished 30 minutes before now; sigma
labels.logic: spot minus that close, divided by sigma
labels.cut: 0.15 sigma, SNDK PRO's own move rule
labels.reads_as: over the last 30 minutes price stayed within 0.15 sigma of where it was, moving -0.03 sigma

labels.from: the last finished bar's high minus low; today's median 1-minute range
labels.logic: this minute's range over a typical minute today
labels.reads_as: this minute's range is 1.5 times a typical minute today, within the 2-times cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the last 30 finished minutes of today's bars; the same clock slot on each prior session
labels.logic: share of prior sessions with less volume in that slot
labels.cut: top fifth at 0.80 or above; bottom fifth at 0.20 or below; needs 5 prior sessions
labels.reads_as: volume over the last 30 minutes is in the top fifth for this time of day, higher than 13 of 16 prior sessions

labels.from: the same, for the last 30 minutes and the 30 before them
labels.logic: each window's band against its own clock slot on prior sessions
labels.cut: the same fifths; needs 60 minutes of session
labels.reads_as: volume during the move, the last 30 minutes, is in the top fifth for its time of day, and volume before the move began, the 30 minutes before that, is in the top fifth for its time of day

labels.from: the last 30 finished bars, each bar's volume and whether it closed above its open
labels.logic: volume in up-closing minutes over all volume
labels.reads_as: 48% of the last 30 minutes' volume printed in minutes that closed up, even within 40% to 60%
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: today's bars, volume bucketed by price in 0.1-sigma bins
labels.logic: where the heaviest bin sits relative to spot
labels.reads_as: the heaviest-volume stretch of the day includes the current price
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: closes now, 10 and 20 minutes ago
labels.logic: the last 10 minutes' move over the 10 before, both in sigma
labels.cut: above 1.5 is bigger; below two thirds is smaller
labels.reads_as: the last 10 minutes moved 0.07 sigma, between two thirds and 1.5 times as far as the 10 minutes before, which moved 0.08 sigma

labels.from: the last five finished bars; the direction of the 30-minute move
labels.logic: bars whose close beat their open in the move's direction
labels.cut: 4 or 5 is most, 2 or 3 is half, 0 or 1 is few; under the 0.15 sigma move rule there is no move to judge
labels.reads_as: of the last five 1-minute bars, 5 closed in the direction of the move, which is up
labels.note: on a quiet read, a 30-minute move under the 0.15 sigma move rule, the sentence says 'no move to judge' and carries the verdict no_move; the label is written, never omitted, so the questions that read it can answer no_move

labels.from: the bars over the last 30 minutes; the move's direction
labels.logic: the longest run without a new extreme, and the deepest dip from the running extreme as a share of the move's full extent
labels.cut: a pullback at 25% or more; a pause of 3 to 10 minutes; a pause longer than 10; under the 0.15 sigma move rule there is no move to judge
labels.reads_as: during the last 30 minutes the move up gave back 40% of itself at its deepest pullback, more than a quarter
labels.note: on a quiet read, a 30-minute move under the 0.15 sigma move rule, the sentence says 'no move to judge' and carries the verdict no_move; the label is written, never omitted, so the questions that read it can answer no_move

labels.from: the first 30 finished bars; the median 1-minute range of the last 30 bars
labels.logic: the opening box's high and low; a break is beyond an edge by more than twice the median minute range, SNDK PRO's move bar
labels.reads_as: price has broken above the opening box and sits 0.81 sigma beyond its top; the box is 1.76 sigma wide

labels.from: today's high minus low over its open; the same clock cut on the prior 5 sessions' bars
labels.logic: share of prior sessions with a smaller range by this minute
labels.reads_as: today's range so far is in the top third of the last 5 sessions at this time of day, larger than 5 of them

labels.from: prior_close on the row; spot; sigma
labels.logic: spot minus last night's close, divided by sigma
labels.cut: 0.15 is at it; 1.0 or more is an outlier day
labels.reads_as: price is 0.35 sigma below last night's close, within 1.0 sigma, an ordinary day so far
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: yesterday's bars: high, low, close; spot; sigma
labels.logic: where spot sits against the three, with each distance in sigma
labels.cut: 0.15 sigma counts as at a level
labels.reads_as: price is inside yesterday's range, 0.42 sigma below its high and 2.14 sigma above its low
labels.note: revised 2026-09-21 after the overlap review; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. the distance to yesterday's close was dropped; price.vs_prior_close owns that number, so JEV never sees it twice with a slightly different value

labels.from: the session before yesterday: high, low, close
labels.logic: the same, one day further back
labels.reads_as: price is 2.01 sigma above the session before yesterday's high, more than the 0.15 sigma move rule; it is 2.16 sigma above the session before yesterday's close
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: today's bars; yesterday's high, low and close; the move bar
labels.logic: for each of yesterday's high, low and close, the number of finished bars today whose range came within the move bar of it
labels.cut: reach is two typical minutes of range, the move bar; no count band, the sentence carries the minutes and the question reads zero against one or more
labels.reads_as: price has spent 42 minutes within reach of yesterday's high, 0 minutes within reach of yesterday's low and 43 minutes within reach of yesterday's close today, counting reach as two typical minutes of range
labels.note: revised 2026-09-21 after the overlap review; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. reworded as minutes within reach, since a bar sitting on a level all afternoon counts every minute; it is not a count of separate visits

labels.from: the side packet's level visits for the wall roles
labels.logic: returns to the nearest heavy strike today
labels.reads_as: price has come back to the nearest heavy strike 4 times today, two or more times
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the side packet's level visits for the session high
labels.logic: returns to the day's high
labels.reads_as: price has come back to the day's high 1 time, once
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the finished 1-minute closes
labels.logic: Wilder's RSI over 14 periods
labels.reads_as: the 1-minute RSI is 60, between 30 and 70
labels.note: read between on 62 of 64 sampled moments over four days

labels.from: closes sampled every 5 minutes
labels.logic: Wilder's RSI over 14 periods
labels.reads_as: the 5-minute RSI is 50, between 30 and 70
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the side packet's episodes for the 14-period RSI
labels.logic: minutes the RSI has held an extreme without a break
labels.reads_as: the 1-minute RSI sits between its overbought and oversold marks right now, so no extreme is being held
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the running volume-weighted average now and 30 minutes ago, from the bars
labels.logic: the difference, divided by sigma
labels.reads_as: the day's average price has stayed within the 0.05 sigma flat cut over the last 30 minutes, moving -0.02 sigma
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the closes of the last 30 minutes of finished bars; the 30-minute move
labels.logic: the net move between the window's first and last close over the sum of every minute-to-minute move; under the 0.15 sigma move rule there is no path to judge
labels.cut: 0.60 or more is orderly; under 0.30 is choppy; between is mixed
labels.reads_as: price stayed within the 0.15 sigma move rule over the last 30 minutes, so there is no path to judge
labels.note: added 2026-09-23 from the intraday question review; sentence rendered from the real row at 2026-09-23 15:58

labels.from: atm_iv now; the row about 30 minutes earlier, within 10 minutes
labels.logic: the difference in vol points
labels.cut: 2 vol points is the flat band; omitted in the last hour of expiry day
labels.reads_as: over the last 30 minutes at-the-money implied volatility stayed within the 2 vol point flat band, changing +1.8 vol points

labels.from: iv_skew.skew_pts, put minus call implied volatility
labels.logic: as given, in vol points
labels.reads_as: calls carry a higher implied volatility than puts at equal distance, by 2.3 vol points

labels.from: range_ruler.em_consumed
labels.logic: today's range over the expected move at the open
labels.reads_as: today's range so far has used 3.3 times today's expected move, more than all of it

labels.from: adaptive_em.down_share
labels.logic: as given
labels.reads_as: the day's expected move splits 49% down and 51% up, even within the 40% to 60% band
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: this week's at-the-money implied volatility minus next week's, both from the chain cache
labels.logic: the difference in vol points; above the flat band this week is hotter, below it cooler, and inside the band the sentence still says which week is higher
labels.reads_as: this week's and next week's at-the-money implied volatility are within the 2 vol point flat band, this week's 0.6 vol points below next week's
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. corrected 2026-09-23: the from was written the wrong way round, and the level branch now names the higher week

labels.from: today's finished bars' high and low, folding in spot
labels.logic: spot minus the low, over the high minus the low
labels.reads_as: price is in the top third of today's range so far, 98% of the way up from the low to the high

labels.from: spot; the row's vwap; sigma
labels.logic: spot minus the average, divided by sigma
labels.reads_as: price is 0.88 sigma above the day's volume-weighted average price, more than the 0.15 sigma move rule
labels.note: the cut phrase was added on 2026-09-21; before that the sentence carried the number alone and the question needed JEV to compare it

labels.from: the high and low over the prior 5 sessions' bars, today excluded
labels.logic: spot minus that low, over that range
labels.cut: above the five-session high or below its low is new ground; inside, the third it sits in, with the distance to both edges in sigma
labels.reads_as: price is in the top third of the last 5 sessions' range, 90% of the way up from its low to its high, 0.42 sigma below that high and 3.72 sigma above their low
labels.note: revised 2026-09-21 after the overlap review; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. now carries the distance to the five-session high and low as well; price.vs_week_extremes folded in. Verdict new_ground_above, new_ground_below or inside_the_week for the week_position question

labels.from: today's finished bars: the first bar's open, the session high and low so far folding in spot; spot; sigma
labels.logic: net is spot minus the open; the rise above the open and the fall below it; the giveback from the high and the recovery from the low, all in sigma. Reversed when an extension of 0.30 or more has given back 0.30 or more and at least half of itself; otherwise rising, falling or flat on net
labels.reads_as: so far today price is 1.01 sigma below the open, more than the 0.30 sigma cut, so the session is falling
labels.note: added 2026-09-23 from the intraday question review; sentence rendered from the real row at 2026-09-23 15:58

labels.from: the row's vwap, call_wall and put_wall; the day's high and low from bars finished before the last 30 minutes; yesterday's high, low and close; the last 30 minutes of finished bars; spot; sigma
labels.logic: the level nearest spot in sigma, then the path to it over the last 30 minutes: crossed up or down when the close 30 minutes ago and spot sit on opposite sides; crossed and back when a bar traded through it but both sit on the same side; otherwise untouched, banded by distance
labels.cut: 0.15 sigma is within reach; 0.5 sigma is near; needs 30 minutes of finished bars
labels.reads_as: in the last 30 minutes price pushed below the day's low and is back above it, 0.13 sigma over
labels.note: added 2026-09-23 from the intraday question review; sentence rendered from the real row at 2026-09-23 15:58

labels.from: gex_views.gamma_above_spot and gamma_below_spot
labels.logic: above over the sum
labels.reads_as: most of the options weight sits above price, 60% of it

labels.from: call_wall, put_wall, spot, sigma
labels.logic: the nearer wall by absolute distance, divided by sigma
labels.reads_as: the nearest heavy strike is the put wall 0.80 sigma below price, more than 0.5 sigma away, with open air between
labels.note: SNDK PRO measured walls as not acting as levels price reaches

labels.from: this row and the last row with a different meta.book_asof: mass_by_strike, call_wall, put_wall, gamma_sign
labels.logic: heaviest strike same or different; each wall same, different, appeared or disappeared; gamma sign matches or differs
labels.reads_as: since the last book, 4 minutes earlier: the heaviest strike now is the same strike as at the last book; the nearest call wall is the same strike as at the last book; the nearest put wall is the same strike as at the last book; the gamma sign now matches the gamma sign at the last book

labels.from: gex_views.vol_gross_by_strike
labels.logic: the three busiest strikes' contracts over all
labels.reads_as: today's contracts trade across many strikes; the three busiest hold 33% of them, less than half
labels.note: read spread_out on all 64 sampled moments, too one-sided to grade

labels.from: gex_views.vol_gross_by_strike; spot
labels.logic: the busiest strike's share of today's option volume; spread out when no strike holds more than a fifth, otherwise whether the busiest strike is the one nearest price, above it or below it
labels.reads_as: today's option volume is spread across strikes, no strike holding more than a fifth of it; the busiest holds 14%
labels.note: added 2026-09-23 from the intraday question review; sentence rendered from the real row at 2026-09-23 15:58

labels.from: gex_views.call_wall_gamma_share and put_wall_gamma_share
labels.logic: the nearest wall's share of all the board's weight
labels.cut: fixed: thin under 5%; thick at 15% or above; middling between
labels.reads_as: the nearest wall, the call wall, holds 13% of all the options weight on the board, middling, between the 5% thin cut and the 15% thick cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: gex_views.pin_top_share
labels.logic: as given
labels.cut: fixed: spread thin under 10%; concentrated at 20% or above; middling between
labels.reads_as: the single heaviest strike holds 16% of the board's weight, middling, between the 10% and 20% cuts
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: dex_views.dex_above_spot
labels.logic: one minus the share above
labels.reads_as: 63% of dealers' directional exposure sits at strikes below price, most of it
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. a location fact only; the accompanying direction word is retired and must not ride along

labels.from: net_exposure.net_delta_total over prev_close_delta
labels.logic: the ratio
labels.reads_as: dealers' directional book is 0.4 times its size at yesterday's close, smaller, below the 0.8 cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. the gamma version is unusable, its denominator crosses zero

labels.from: call_wall against call_wall_tenor; put_wall against put_wall_tenor
labels.logic: whether today's book and the later-dated book defend the same strikes
labels.reads_as: on the call side the later-dated book defends the same strike as today's book; on the put side the later-dated book defends the same strike as today's book
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: profile_ladder.state
labels.logic: one of four named gamma situations; the two transition states are the new information
labels.reads_as: the board's gamma ladder is in the positive state
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-18 15:49

labels.from: gex_views.oi_side_by_strike at the heaviest strike; the last diary row of the most recent earlier session
labels.logic: grew, shrank or held against yesterday's closing row; a heaviest strike absent from yesterday's closing book is left out as unknown, never guessed; zero open interest there yesterday reads built today
labels.reads_as: the crowd at the heaviest strike shrank 51% overnight, more than the 10% cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. omitted on any day the heaviest strike sat outside yesterday's closing book, so the questions reading it are skipped that read

labels.from: gex_views.shove.shove_down_margin and shove_up_margin
labels.logic: if price moved half a normal day, the dealers' cushion as a multiple of now; clamped to plus or minus 3
labels.reads_as: if price were shoved up by half a normal move for the time left, the dealers' calming gamma would be 1.0 times what it is now, the same sign; shoved down, it would be 1.0 times what it is now, the same sign
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. raw tails reach 429 when gamma at spot is near zero, hence the clamp; shove_sigma itself is only the session clock and is rejected

labels.from: vol_side_by_strike over oi_side_by_strike
labels.logic: contracts traded today over the standing open position
labels.cut: 1.0 and 3.0: under 1 times; between 1 and 3 times; more than 3 times
labels.reads_as: today's contracts traded are 3.1 times the standing open position, more than 3 times it
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: vol_side_by_strike, calls against puts
labels.logic: calls over the sum
labels.reads_as: 59% of today's contracts traded near price were calls, an even split within 40% to 60%
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. what traded, never who pressed; SNDK has no buy-or-sell tape

labels.from: vol_side_by_strike_next against the front
labels.logic: next week's contracts over both
labels.reads_as: 10% of contracts traded went to next week's expiry rather than the front one, a small share, under the 25% cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the at-the-money bid and ask in the chain cache
labels.logic: ask minus bid over the mid
labels.reads_as: the at-the-money spread is 3% of the mid, wider than the 3% cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: the at-the-money bid_size and ask_size in the chain cache
labels.logic: bid size over the sum
labels.reads_as: 88% of the size showing on the at-the-money quote is on the bid, more size on the bid, beyond the 60% cut
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

labels.from: gex_views.mass_by_strike, vol_side_by_strike, net_by_strike; spot; sigma
labels.logic: the three nearest qualifying strikes each side, each written as one sentence: distance in sigma, share of board weight, and whether calls or puts dominated today's contracts there
labels.cut: a strike qualifies with 5% or more of the board's weight, or a top-8 rank by contracts
labels.reads_as: 0.04 sigma above price: 4% of the board's weight, calls and puts traded there evenly today | 0.18 sigma above price: 4% of the board's weight, calls and puts traded there evenly today | 0.32 sigma above price: 3% of the board's weight, calls and puts traded there evenly today | 0.10 sigma below price: 3% of the board's weight, mostly calls traded there today | 0.25 sigma below price: 8% of the board's weight, calls and puts traded there evenly today | 0.95 sigma below price: 12% of the board's weight, calls and puts traded there evenly today
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59. a description of structure; walls measured as not acting as levels on this name. List strikes nearest-first on each side, so a question can read the first strike listed. A list, nearest strike first on each side

labels.from: net_by_strike through the cluster rule SNDK PRO already has for its structure block
labels.logic: whether adjacent heavy strikes form a band, its span and share
labels.cut: a band is 2 or more adjacent strikes each above 5%
labels.reads_as: no two adjacent strikes each holding 5% or more of the weight sit within 1 sigma of price, so there is no band near price
labels.note: built 2026-09-21; rendered from the real row at 2026-09-21 15:59

folded.why: both said where we are in the session; progress now carries the fifth, the phase name and the minutes to the open and close
both read the same five-session high and low; one label now carries the third, new ground and the distance to both edges

review.method: replayed every fourth stored row over the last ten sessions (401 moments, 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-21) through build_ab; counted each label's verdict and measured normalised mutual information between every pair of verdict labels

one_sided.kept_as: a label only; the rsi_band question was already dropped
a label only; option_activity is a calibration control
live, under the 90% line; expected_move_skew stays but is watched

overlap_found.decision: kept both; the day's average price and the day's range are different objects, and questions read them separately
kept both; gamma side and delta side disagree most of the time, so they are not the same fact

review.not_measurable: 43 of the 61 labels write no verdict, so overlap between them was judged from their inputs, not from replay
